concepts.primary_text:
A classic profile, reimagined with contemporary poise.

The Camille reimagines the 18th-century French Salon for the modern home - high-end tailoring softened by gentle curves and finished with a crisp box-pleated skirt.

Customise the height, width, depth, fill and more, then choose from over 200 premium and luxury fabrics to create your dream sofa.
concepts.headline: Tailored for the modern salon
concepts.why_it_works: A 5,308 dollar sofa needs its design credentials stacked visibly before the click, and the callouts let the tailoring details justify the price inside the creative.
concepts.visual_direction: The Camille sofa centred in a bright modern living room, with fine leader lines pointing to its tailoring, box-pleated skirt, and French-salon design cues.

claims_used: Proudly locally crafted here in Australia and though handpicked artisans across the globe
copy_claims: Designed in Australia, produced by expert makers locally and around the world
Working with leading designers, interior stylists and retail customers since 2015
concepts.primary_text:
Proudly locally crafted here in Australia and through handpicked artisans across the globe.

The Camille Arm Chair takes an 18th-century French Salon silhouette, a crisp box-pleated skirt and a solid wood frame, and reimagines it with contemporary poise.

We have been working with leading designers and interior stylists since 2015, and we don't place limits on your vision. Backed by a limited 7 year frame warranty.
concepts.headline: Crafted by artisans, backed 7 years
concepts.why_it_works: The box-pleat skirt, solid wood frame and 7 year warranty are a genuine craft story no mass retailer can copy, so showing the workshop earns the premium price instead of arguing for it.
concepts.visual_direction: The Camille armchair in an Australian upholstery workshop, surrounded by the timber frame, fabric offcuts and tailoring tools that go into making it.

copy_claims: one single continuous full-length seat cushion
concepts.primary_text:
260 cm of seamless curve, one continuous seat, zero hard edges.

The Miller commands the room with a suave, sculptural presence - a low, floor-skimming silhouette built on a solid wood frame and shaped entirely from soft, sweeping arcs.

Designed in Australia and made your way, across dimensions, cushion fills and over 200 premium fabrics.
concepts.headline: A sofa that fills the room
concepts.why_it_works: The 260 cm length and single full-width cushion are the Miller's most striking, provable specs, so we stage the sheer scale physically to make the presence undeniable before the click.
concepts.visual_direction: The full 260 cm terracotta Miller sofa shot wide and low in an almost empty warm-neutral room, with a floor lamp and a standing person beside it to show just how long and low it really is.
